notes: Cash is GDD dollars (#91: x10 from the old $K economy). Social venues the CEO can attend to meet guests and turn them into leads (director note D2). Cash in dollars, time in agenda days (the CEO has a limited number per quarter). guestPool.classes are relative weights over GDD wealth classes C1-C5; classes that have not arrived yet in the campaign are skipped when a guest list is drawn. exposure: heat and reputation change per attendance, press = chance a journalist is in the room.

venues.name: Heartland Preparedness Fair
venues.blurb: Funnel cakes, generator demos and a man selling forty-year honey. Nervous millionaires in fleece vests.

venues.name: End Times Prepper Expo
venues.blurb: A convention centre in the desert full of camo. The wealthy ones wear the clean camo.

venues.name: Last Resort Charity Golf Classic
venues.blurb: Eighteen holes for a cause nobody can name. Spring and autumn only; the greens are too nice for winter.

venues.name: State Funeral of a Tycoon
venues.blurb: Someone very rich died of something very preventable. Everyone at the wake is thinking about their own.

venues.name: Coastal Yacht Week
venues.blurb: Three days of hopping between boats that each cost more than a town. The sea level is not discussed.

venues.name: Disrupt the End Founder Summit
venues.blurb: Keynotes on surviving the singularity, sponsored by the companies building it. Lanyards are titanium.

venues.name: Old Capitals Embassy Ball
venues.blurb: Chandeliers, string quartets and two ambassadors pretending not to see each other. Old money, older grudges.

venues.name: Ice Hotel Winter Retreat
venues.blurb: Winter quarters only. Dynasties in furs comparing permafrost acreage over vodka served in ice.

venues.name: Equatorial Longevity Retreat
venues.blurb: Cold plunges, blood swaps and a shaman with a Series B. Everyone wants to live forever; you sell the somewhere.

venues.name: Global Resilience Forum
venues.blurb: Private jets land by the hundred so their owners can discuss the climate. The press pit is right by the bar.

venues.name: Island Havens Midnight Art Auction
venues.blurb: Bidding opens at midnight on a volcano. Paddles are gold. The art is mostly of the bidders.

venues.name: The Table's Private Supper
venues.blurb: Nine chairs, no phones, no minutes. Being invited is the price; the five million is just the cover charge.
